channel.title: The Kimberley Echo - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kimberley Echo (kimberleyecho.com.au)

item.title: Award-worthy Kimberley stays
item.description: Two Kimberley accommodation venues are celebrating after a string of staff were named finalists in the 2026 AHA Perth Airport Accommodation Awards.

item.title: Kimberley GPs awarded for decades of service awards
item.description: Five Kimberley doctors were honoured at the annual WA Rural Health Long Service Awards, hosted by Rural Health West and the WA Country Health Service

item.title: Narrowing the digital gap for First Nations communities
item.description: Remote Kimberley communities are set to receive a major connectivity boost, with free community Wi-Fi to be rolled out under the State Government’s $20 million First Nations Community Wi-Fi program

item.title: Airnorth unveils Kimberley Locals Fare for Broome–Kununurra route
item.description: Airnorth has launched a new discounted airfare aimed at improving access and affordability for Kimberley residents travelling between Broome and Kununurra.

item.title: New Derby Early Learning and Family Centre
item.description: Funding announced this week for a new Early Learning and Family Centre in Derby due to open in 2029

item.title: Firearms ‘stolen’ from Derby licence holder recovered in crackdown on unlawful possession
item.description: Police have recovered two firearms reported as stolen amid ongoing Statewide action targeting the unlawful possession of guns in the community.

item.title: Kalumburu community unites for Ochre Ribbon march to end family violence
item.description: The Kalumburu community came together in strength and solidarity for an Ochre Ribbon Week march on February 12 to raise awareness about ending family and domestic violence

item.title: Jump in family violence sparks calls for long-term solutions in Kimberley
item.description: Figures released earlier this month by the WA Police Force, highlight a steady year-on-year increase in recorded assault offences in the Kimberley

item.title: Durack community organisations urged to apply for vollie grant funding
item.description: Community organisations throughout the Pilbara are being urged to apply for Federal funding aimed at boosting support for volunteers.

item.title: Kimberley’s rural clinicians connect
item.description: The Kimberley Health Professionals Network has kicked off the year with a welcome event in Broome, designed to support rural clinicians and strengthen the region’s health workforce
